command: Pseudomonas putida KT2440 PvdD (Q88F79, PP_4219) participates in monocarboxylic acid biosynthesis (GO:0072330) through construction of its native pyoverdine. Determine the structures and count of free carboxyl groups for the actual KT2440 products, including succinamide/cyclized PVD2 and the linear or succinate variants, using primary structural papers PMID:25895945 and PMID:28631237 and subsequent PMID:31451546. Verify which groups are carboxylic acids versus amides or cyclic hydroxamates; do not infer the count solely from amino-acid names. Relate the demonstrated NRPS reaction to the GO definition and chemical-class ontology. Being a pyoverdine rather than enterobactin synthetase does not alone exclude this broad chemical class.
